# Catster

> Catster is a comprehensive resource for cat health, care, and wellness information created by veterinarians and expert contributors.

Catster provides evidence-based guidance on cat care, nutrition, grooming, and health topics, along with vetted product recommendations from trusted brands. The site is authored by veterinary professionals and pet care experts including Dr. Karyn Kanowski, Sara Seitz, and other specialists.

- pet care guides
- cat nutrition
- cat grooming
